shorts.providerOrder: Eligible paid MoolSocial Reels remain first; eligible YouTube Shorts participate in the same continuous vertical flow.
shorts.stage: One edge-to-edge Shorts canvas for MoolSocial and YouTube with no provider-specific side shrink.
shorts.fit: Center-crop inside the 9:16 safe canvas; never stretch media. Keep faces, titles, commerce and controls inside protected overlays.
shorts.chrome: Show controls when an item opens, hide after 2800 ms, restore on a non-action tap; keep required sponsored identity visible.
shorts.youtubeBoundary: YouTube attribution and official-player behavior remain visible and accurate. MoolSocial actions remain distinct from YouTube account actions.

bottomRail.focusedMode: The middle ribbon exposes every sub-action for the active world.
bottomRail.moolMode: Tapping Mool replaces only the middle ribbon with Social, Buy, Eat, Ride, Book, Pay and Work.
bottomRail.motion: A 280 ms selection lift and 460 ms restrained sheen acknowledge the active destination; progress movement reflects the selected world.
bottomRail.nativeHaptics: Use Flutter selection haptics for ribbon choices and a light impact for Mool, world and Chat transitions. Respect platform accessibility settings.

typographyAndFitment.rule: Scale type by semantic role and available space. Preserve readable titles, metadata and action labels without crowding or clipping.
typographyAndFitment.overflow: No horizontal page overflow, clipped action label, inaccessible content or undersized visible action.

customerCopy.rule: Visible copy contains only customer-facing actions, facts, outcomes, disclosures and recovery guidance.

nativeRules: Implement with native Flutter widgets; never render this HTML in a WebView.
Reuse existing non-UI sessions, services and route owners.
Do not import or modify the legacy Flutter presentation.
Do not modify accepted Screens 01, 02 or 03.
Do not claim native acceptance before identical-viewport comparison and connected OPPO replay.
